verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so neither is the better resize. Both have the same flaws: the headline is set so large that 'botanicals' runs almost edge to edge with no side margin. It also breaks into five ragged lines, leaving 'little' alone on its own line. The subline sits after an oversized, uneven gap below the headline, and the CTA is pushed close to the bottom edge, so the vertical spacing feels uneven rather than planned. Brand colours, fonts and hierarchy do survive.
